/* only one invoice empty state, inside the items area */ #invoiceItemsContainer .adt-invoice-empty-inline{ display:flex!important; min-height:105px!important; margin:4px 0 0!important; border:1px solid rgba(0,210,180,.32)!important; border-radius:12px!important; background:rgba(7,16,27,.65)!important; } /* Invoice item editor stays at the top and remains usable with the keyboard open */ #invoiceItemEditModal.adt-invoice-item-modal{ align-items:flex-start!important; justify-content:center!important; padding:8px 10px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important; overflow-y:auto!important; } #invoiceItemEditModal .adt-invoice-item-compact{ width:min(94vw,360px)!important; max-width:360px!important; margin:0 auto!important; max-height:calc(100dvh - 16px)!important; overflow-y:auto!important; overscroll-behavior:contain!important; border-radius:16px!important; } #invoiceItemEditModal .btn-primary, #invoiceItemEditModal .btn-secondary{ min-height:44px!important; position:relative!important; z-index:2!important; } @media(max-height:620px){ #invoiceItemEditModal.adt-invoice-item-modal{padding-top:4px!important} #invoiceItemEditModal .adt-invoice-item-compact{max-height:calc(100dvh - 8px)!important;padding:12px!important} #invoiceItemEditModal .form-group{margin-bottom:8px!important} #invoiceItemEditModal textarea{min-height:48px!important} }
